summary: A radio-broadcast themed single page: a fixed bottom 'tuner' bar maps scroll progress onto five frequencies (MCNK 87.8, MONO 91.2, SEMI 95.6, POLY 97.7, INFO 99.2), each chapter announced by a giant blended frequency overlay. Chapters are bento panels of Lottie-animated electro-mechanical props (printers, consoles, QSL cards, transmission logs) with section copy hidden behind '(i) Info!' popovers; the type tester is an off-canvas postcard maker that mails a real printed card.

instances.look: Abbreviated name 'MCNK' in magenta filling the full width, above a dashboard of instrument tiles: a tone cone diagram (MONO → SEMI → POLY spheres), an outlined Poly 'm', yellow dots spelling MECHANIK, two spoked wheels, a colophon address in mono, then an 'an' on a pink grid with TONE/WGHT readouts and a ring dial, then pictogram tiles (plug socket, 'k', 'i', smiley)
instances.feel: Lab equipment manual, cheerful and precise
instances.ux: TV test-card loader ('PLEASE STAND BY') for ~2s; wheels rotate with scroll; the 'an' tile steps through tone (Mono/Semi/Poly) and weight (Thin–Black), highlighting the active label in magenta while a ring dial marks the weight; fixed tuner nav at the bottom with Type Tester / Try / Buy
instances.learn: Abbreviate the name to its consonants (MCNK) to get a compact, machine-like wordmark that can fill the width, then let a dashboard of diagram tiles explain the family system before any copy
